heading: How to order
intro: Ordering is done by quote, so every price matches your brand mix, grade and quantity.

steps.title: Send us your list
steps.text: Categories, brands, sizes and how many pieces. Minimum 10.

steps.title: Get a quote with photos
steps.text: We reply with a price and real photos or video of your bundle.

steps.title: Pay and confirm
steps.text: Pay by the method agreed on your quote, and we lock in your bundle.

steps.title: We pack and ship
steps.text: Packed in Karachi and shipped with tracking to your door.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order?
faqs.answer: 10 pieces. You can mix brands within a category.

faqs.question: Can I mix brands?
faqs.answer: Yes. We sell single-brand bundles and mixed-brand bundles, depending on what is in stock.

faqs.question: Can I see the pieces before I pay?
faqs.answer: Yes. We send real photos or a video of the exact bundle with your quote.

faqs.question: Where do you ship?
faqs.answer: From Karachi to the US, UK and Europe, with tracking.

faqs.question: How is condition graded?
faqs.answer: Each piece is checked by hand before packing, and the condition is noted on your quote.

faqs.question: Why are there no prices on the site?
faqs.answer: Prices depend on brand mix, grade and quantity, and stock changes daily. Send us your list and we will quote you.
